name: nixpkgs-multiverse
tagline: Every version of nixpkgs from a single flake input
description: nixpkgs-multiverse lets you access every historical version of any nixpkgs package from one flake input. Instead of juggling multiple flake inputs or vendoring nixpkgs snapshots to pin a version, you get a single input that can reference any package at any point in its history. It solves the classic nixpkgs version-pinning pain point — and at 226 stars with only 3 forks, it is still remarkably under-engaged.
highlights: All nixpkgs package versions reachable from one flake input
Ends the multi-input dance for version-pinned packages
226 stars with only 3 forks — deeply under-engaged
curatorNote: Anyone who has fought nixpkgs version pinning knows the pain this removes. A single input that exposes the whole history is the kind of idea that looks obvious only after someone ships it.
